title: Traceability Matrix
description: Trace links between requirements, test cases and results; supports requirements-based coverage

requirement_id.description: HLR/LLR identifier (owned by the requirements tool)

level.description: Requirement level (requirements are HLR or LLR; 'integration' is a test level, not a requirement level)

test_case_ids.description: Test cases tracing to the requirement

normal_range_covered.description: True if at least one linked test case has test_type normal_range

robustness_covered.description: True if at least one linked test case has test_type robustness

run_ids.description: IDs of test runs (test-run.run_id) whose results exercised the linked test cases. Individual verification results have no ID of their own.
